data.name: Синеморск oil inclusive
data.detailed_description:
It might seem that the main threat in an environmental disaster is the fuel oil itself. It poisons the sea and the land, suffocates birds and dolphins, and contaminates food and drinking water. But environmental journalist Lena must fight not only against the oil, but also against the indifference of officials, the distrust of local residents, and the lack of coordination among hundreds of volunteers.

As Lena, make decisions on how best to handle the disaster: whether to follow your intuition or trust the people around you. All your choices affect the story and Lena herself: what she will sacrifice to save the coast, whom she will trust and whom she will betray, and whether she can cope with the pressure and exhaustion. And what should she do about the faint white haze she sees every time she looks out at the shore littered with dead fish?

Features:

— A story with multiple possible outcomes: the game offers dozens of ways to play and over forty endings;

— Conflicts with the system, with individuals, and with her own weaknesses: it’s easy to see yourself in Lena;

— Conditions close to reality: the game is based on interviews with real volunteers who came in 2025–2026 to save the southern city of Anapa from the consequences of an oil spill.

data.short_description: A visual novel about an environmental disaster. Coordinate volunteers, make difficult decisions, and try to survive as you try to save a coastal town dying from an oil spill.
